name: SWIR XBookmark
title: 10.20 BETA — FRIEND IDENTITY GUARD
friends_policy: 10.20 keeps the confirmed 10.17 APK Exact Rooms core but canonicalizes friend identity before lookup and sync
identity_policy: strip only phone markers, zero-width/NBSP noise and trailing colon from friend identity; dedupe local friend list and identity cache; preserve backup before migration
context_menu_policy: friend add/remove uses the actual clicked native nick, never the legacy context-menu header text
connection_policy: native getUserWithName is preserved first; canonical UserData scan is fallback only when exact lookup fails
phone_policy: native mobile icon is hidden visually but never used as part of the login identity
mix_policy: 10.19 Color-aligned MIX 8/8 is frozen and loaded unchanged
launcher_policy: Stable and Beta remain separate; 10.20 is current beta; 10.19 remains writing rollback and 10.17 remains clean Friends baseline
